name: Analytical scans, 1M rows, WARM (Basin v57 vs Neon free)
claim: Where Basin earns its keep: warm steady-state analytical scans at 1M rows. These are genuine 'we scan faster' wins — Basin reads and aggregates the data, just faster than a row store. p50 ms, lower is better.

metrics.label: sum(amount), numeric_only — SELECT sum(amount) FROM t
count(DISTINCT tenant_id), wide_pk — SELECT count(DISTINCT tenant_id) FROM t
top_k, wide_pk — SELECT id,amount FROM t ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 50
group_by top20, wide_pk — SELECT tenant_id,count(*),sum(amount) FROM t GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20
full_agg(count,avg), wide_pk — SELECT count(*),avg(amount) FROM t

note: Warm = steady-state p50 (repeat-read, caches hot). Identical 1M-row workload, co-located Frankfurt loader. These are scan wins: Basin actually reads and aggregates the rows. SQL for each metric is shown in its label.
